scope: Actual finite-dimensional softmax and log-sum-exp first/second derivatives along arbitrary affine lines; not a proof of global convexity or monotonicity of the final two-stream split.
findings: expSum is the finite sum of ordinary real exponentials; softmax uses its genuine quotient.
Finite nonempty index assumptions imply strict positivity of expSum and exclude undefined empty softmax.
affineLine is a+t*v on every real t with arbitrary signed intercept and direction.
mean and variance use the same softmax weights and a genuine centered second moment.
Derivative of log-sum-exp equals mean, derivative of mean equals variance, and the first/second softmax derivatives include the normalization terms.
No derivative, differentiability, covariance, convexity, or positivity conclusion is smuggled in as a hypothesis.

cases: singleton softmax exactly one at arbitrary real logit
symmetric binary softmax at zero: first derivative 1/2
symmetric binary log-sum-exp at zero: first derivative0
symmetric binary log-sum-exp at zero: second derivative1
symmetric binary softmax at zero: second derivative0
